title: Settlement patterns and water access
summary: Compare a heritage location with present-day mapped water and separate observation from historical inference.
body: Use the site's live terrain sample below. Modern proximity is useful context, but rivers and irrigation works change over time.
steps: Choose a heritage location and inspect its mapped-water distance.
Disable slope, then relative lower position. Record how the unnormalised weighted score changes.
Explain why today's nearest water feature cannot prove ancient water access.
Identify the dated landscape evidence and independent observations needed before making a settlement claim.
